title: API Documentation
description: The self-documenting REST API. Record types, fields, and permissions are generated live from the database schema — including your custom records and fields.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Pass your API key as a bearer token. Keys are scoped — a request is allowed only when both the key's scopes and the owner's permissions cover it.

console.tokenNote: Paste a key from API Keys. It stays in this browser tab and is sent only to this API.
console.needToken: Enter an API key above to send requests.
console.responseIdle: Send a request to see the response here.
console.readOnly: This record type is read-only through the API.
console.selectType: Select a record type to build a request.
